Rep. McCaul Seeks Answers From Jensen Huang
videos.description: Republican Congressman Michael McCaul tells Bloomberg This Weekend that he wants answers from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang about the company’s chip sales and whether advanced AI technology reached China in violation of US export controls, amid scrutiny of Huang’s relationship with a woman accused of ties to Chinese intelligence. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, McCaul also says Vladimir Putin is an adversary rather than a US friend, calls for investment to strengthen vulnerable federal technology systems and urges Republicans to learn from their midterm losses as he prepares to leave Congress. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.description: The number of cyberattacks spiked in 2020 and has remained elevated since, posing a threat to the businesses, infrastructure, and critical systems we depend on. videos.title: GTA VI Takes Over Thanksgiving Week
videos.description: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg reporter Josyana Joshua tells host Lisa Mateo how the long-awaited release of Grand Theft Auto VI is becoming a cultural and workplace phenomenon, with gamers taking time off and preparing to play through Thanksgiving week. Joshua explains how the game’s 13-year buildup is driving demand for consoles and gaming gear while potentially competing with family gatherings, football and other holiday entertainment. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
